core_result: Machine-checks 23 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems (T1a-T3h, 14 files / 6,272 lines) spanning Coded/Byzantine PIR (CS-053), Module-LWE reduction tightness & constant-time Dyadic-256/Dyadic-512 + exact FIPS 203 DFRs (CS-026/QC-042/CM-048), and Exact Strassen-Winograd rank_F(<2,2,2>)=7, All-m Koszul MatMul rank >= m^2+2, & complexity-theoretic barriers around P != NP, matrix multiplication omega, and VP vs VNP (CS-001/CS-004/CS-010/CS-012/CS-051). Pillar I (CS-053): resolves the open Schur-product syzygy rank problem of Sun-Tao-Xu-Zhang (arXiv:2603.10769) via shifted-difference Koszul-Veronese moment annihilation over any CommRing with exact Pascal savings, raising Example VII.A (6,3,3) from 4/7 to zero-error 10/17 even over F_7 (T1a); proves K<->T symmetry and universal strict domination over Sun-Zhang (arXiv:2610.37412) LFSR capacity by (K-1)(T-1)E^2 > 0 in both single-file and P-out-of-M multi-file regimes (T1b); establishes Byzantine-robust double-counting converse reduction, exact unrestricted capacity at E=K+1 (breaking E>=KT for all K>=2), and kernel-certifies an explicit F_11 zero-error Byzantine rate-2/5 witness at (M=2,N=6,K=2,T=2,B=1,E=4) with all 90 exact matrix inverses (T1c); proves sharp flag-privacy thresholds and overlap feasibility Ew <= K*delta*sigma (T1d); kernel-certifies ([propext] alone) a 330-orbit scale-128 pure-integer 12-variable polymatroid h_uncond satisfying all 270,336 elemental Shannon inequalities, 99 PIR equalities, 1,485 singleton Ingletons, and 3,814,209 retrieval-subsystem Ingletons at 8/13 > 3/5 (T1e); proves projective P^3 linear impossibility over any SimpleField F (T1f); proves exact algebraic Zhang-Yeung (1998) reduction and symmetric M >= 3 1-flag Koszul breaking E >= KT (T1g); and proves a universal 7-parameter non-Shannon cone reduction showing h_uncond simultaneously defeats ALL infinitely many Matus (2007) inequalities M_s (forall s in N, recovering ZY98 at s=1; 14,850 singleton s=1..5 checks with 0 violations) plus exact all-M Koszul contraction rho_KV^j < rho_LFSR^j (T1h). Pillar II (CS-026/QC-042/CM-048): proves determinant-ideal secret independence det(B)=q^m over any CommRing refuting Luo arXiv:2604.15858 (T2a); proves ring-universal anti-periodic DFT cancellation (Chen ePrint 2024/555 Step 9, T2b) and its universal m-twisted DFT selection rule ([propext] alone, T2f); certifies FIPS 203 CBD2/CBD3 moments, cyclotomic trace-orthogonality, and 60-digit 4.96x Renyi-2 cliff (T2c); establishes QGTL shifted-LWE Berry curvature (T2d); proves Cauchy-Schwarz finite-support Renyi-2 floor, optimal 1-byte constant-time Dyadic-256 (Var=1, 17.7x collapse to 2.138 bits at ML-KEM-1024 and 1.604 bits at ML-KEM-768), QGTL Provost-Vallee PSD 4 det(g) >= Omega^2, and Metric-Kurtosis ordering 3/8 < 15/32 < 1/2 (T2e); and proves a universal non-asymptotic Pearson chi^2/Hermite-4 QGTL variational Renyi-2 bridge (capturing 75.5% of R2-1 for CBD2 and 89.5% for Dyadic-256 at sigma=1) plus optimal 9-bit constant-time zero-excess-kurtosis Dyadic-512 (Var=3/2, mu4=27/4, exact kappa_ex=0, exact Gaussian QGTL det(g)=1/2, 12.89x collapse from 7.630 to 0.592 bits at ML-KEM-512) with exact FIPS 203 discrete-convolution DFRs passing all three NIST targets (2^-139.26, 2^-166.12, 2^-174.26; T2g). Pillar III (CS-001/CS-004/CS-010/CS-012/CS-051): formalizes constructive multilinear-extension uniqueness over any field (Algebrization core, T3a), LWE PRF -> Natural Proofs obstruction (T3b), Katz-Trevisan B-Byzantine PIR <-> LDC distance 2B+1 (T3c) and smoothness plus Shannon (1949) circuit counting (T3f), sharp FIPS 203 Compress_1 margin |e| <= 831 (failing at +832, T3d), field-universal Landsberg-Ottaviani Koszul flattenings (rank_F(T_3)>=5, T3e), a symbolic ALL-m 1-nnz/row monomial left-inverse proving rank_F(<m,m,m>) >= m^2+2 for EVERY m >= 2 and EVERY field F incl. char 2 plus degree-(m-1) ceiling m^2+m (with Phi_2(<3,3,3>) exact rank 324 over F_2 & F_101 giving >= 12; T3g), and complete characteristic-free Exact Strassen-Winograd rank_F(<2,2,2>) = 7 over EVERY SimpleField F including F_2 (T3h, StrassenWinograd.lean). Verified across 6/6 Lean kernels (2,963-2,995 decls), zero-warning C11 + ASan/UBSan + 512/512 fuzz (57/57 unit tests), Eshkol v1.3.6 AD (3/3, <2e-13), 16/16 pytest (10/10 mutants killed), 28/28 live HTTP-200 citations, 100.0% Build Standard v1.2.0 (69/69 applicable, 29/29 core, A27 PASS), live interactive 23-theorem GitHub Pages Proof Blueprint, and a 16-page 0-overfull AMS-LaTeX preprint + clean-room arXiv tarball.
